summary: 29-year-old New York woman belaying at Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park, injured when her male lead partner slipped ~8 ft and landed on her; left-eye laceration, back and neck pain, left-leg numbness despite wearing a helmet; medical care on scene, evacuated to Boulder Community Hospital.
location: Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: BW police-blotter item "Grounded at Red Garden"; run 712.
